palette_grid_direct_click.unsaved_selection_behavior: CRITICAL: Direct clicking a palette number DOES NOT call saveSelection(). Any unconfirmed radio button selected on the current question is abandoned and NOT saved to quesAnswer[]. If the previous question had not been answered, it remains in State 1 (Not Answered, red shield).
